title: National Building Code of India 2016
disclaimer: An encoded subset of NBC 2016 Part 3 room requirements. The NBC is a model code with no force of its own: states and municipal corporations adopt it through their own building bye-laws and amend it, and the local development control rules govern setbacks, ground coverage and FSI. Confirm every finding against the bye-laws for the municipality.

rules.title: Habitable room area
rules.message: {name} is {area_m2} m²; 9.5 m² is the commonly cited minimum for a habitable room.
rules.note: A single-roomed dwelling is treated differently. Municipal bye-laws vary.

rules.title: Habitable room least width
rules.message: {name} is {width_mm} mm across; 2400 mm is the commonly cited minimum.

rules.title: Kitchen area
rules.message: {name} is {area_m2} m² and {width_mm} mm wide; 5.0 m² and 1800 mm are commonly cited.

rules.title: Bathroom area
rules.message: {name} is {area_m2} m²; 1.8 m² is commonly cited for a bathroom.

rules.title: Clear ceiling height
rules.message: {name} has about {clear_height_mm} mm clear; 2750 mm is commonly required for a habitable room.

rules.title: Passage width
rules.message: {name} is {width_mm} mm wide; 1000 mm is commonly cited for a residential passage.

rules.title: Stair width
rules.message: The stair is {width_mm} mm wide; 1000 mm is commonly cited for residential.

rules.title: Riser height
rules.message: The riser is {riser_mm} mm; 190 mm is the commonly cited cap for residential.

rules.title: Tread depth
rules.message: The tread is {going_mm} mm; 250 mm is commonly cited for residential.
